name: Known CVE / public PoC
steps: Confirm the exact product and version, then look up CVEs and public PoCs (cve_lookup).
Prefer a maintained PoC that matches the version; clone it locally.
Read its usage; adapt target / listener / callback parameters; run it the way its authors intend.
Confirm the documented effect (code execution, auth bypass, data read) before declaring success.
If it fails after a few honest attempts, abandon it and pivot to another hypothesis.
